experiment: controlled three-seed comparison of the complete btt_policy_obs_v3_entities observation package against the reproduced Phase K btt_policy_obs_v1 control
status: corrected before launch on the user's review (2026-09-26): three narrow corrections to m7n_decision_rule_v1; frozen when the campaign manifest pins this file's sha256; no training had started under v1

supersedes.preserved: byte-identical at its path; never used for a decision

corrections.what: the ceiling criterion X no longer accepts a raw live x < -2100 entry (M7h showed an off-stage fall satisfies it). X = 1 needs a replay-verified qualified wall crossing with a valid left-side landing (criterion btt_qualified_crossing_v1, rl/m7n_crossing.py: btt_reward_v3 over_wall entry + btt_crossing_evidence_v1 over_ledge path with a grounded takeoff + a grounded step on a decoded left-side floor line inside the same left visit, not the failure step) OR a replay-verified left-target break; the same criterion and code path are applied to every control seed (R4 of the control check and the campaign's verify-crossings); the control-clear guard is unchanged

the explanation of improvement_over_control is corrected: one native-verified v3 clear with no control clear legitimately decides gate 1 (a single seed CAN carry the first-clear condition); the no-pooling / no-single-seed statement applies to gates 2-5

T is undefined (null), never 0, when every stochastic episode of a label is a verified clear; D and G are undefined when either operand is; gates 3 and 4 are inapplicable unless D is defined in every seed, and a seed with undefined G never counts toward gate 5 (gate 5 is inapplicable when fewer than no_learning_seeds_min seeds have G defined); an inapplicable gate never decides and evaluation continues to the next gate; gate 1 depends on K only, so clear-first precedence needs no exception and no fabricated number

synthetic_cases_added: off-stage left entry (exact replay, unqualified) in every seed
one qualified crossing + one left-target break
a control candidate that does not qualify does not block gate 2
a control qualified crossing blocks gate 2
an inexact crossing candidate is integrity
single-seed first clear (one clear in one seed, worse targets elsewhere)
all-clear v3 label (T undefined) with no control clear
all-clear v3 seed against a control clear in that seed (gates 3-4 inapplicable)
undefined G in two seeds (gate 5 inapplicable)

question: Does the complete v3 observation package, taken together, let PPO learn more Mario Break the Targets from normal tick-0 starts than v1 at 3,072,000 policy transitions, everything else matched?
not_isolated: the arms differ in the whole observation package (geometry, agent state, action classes, target motion, projectiles, fixed scaling versus running normalisation, input width); no gate attributes an effect to one component, and nothing here tests why the Phase K v2 comparison gave no benefit

v3.initialisation: fresh models; the input shape (606) cannot load any v1 / v2 checkpoint; no pilot checkpoint, optimizer state or statistics is reused

v1.reuse_condition: the all-three-seed reproduction check (R1 pinned checkpoint digests and rows, R2 all 600 final evaluation episodes, R3 decision inputs) PASSED on the manifest's code fingerprint and executable; a failed check is an integrity problem: the campaign stops and diagnoses, and the control is never replaced by newly trained runs by this rule

pairing: seeds 0, 1, 2 paired by seed number; every per-seed quantity compares m7n_s{s}_v3 with m7g_s{s}_v1
matched: PPO of rl/configs/m7g: 3e-4, rollout 5,120 = 5 x 1,024, batch 512, 10 epochs, gamma 0.999, lambda 0.995, clip 0.2, ent_coef 0, vf_coef 0.5, max_grad_norm 0.5
N = 5 workers with one standby each (<= 10 game processes)
tick-0 starts only; no curriculum, prefix, anchor or archive
3,072,000 policy transitions per run; checkpoints every 102,400

the M7e / Phase K post-hoc evaluation: initial + 9 curve points + final; 100 stochastic + 100 deterministic at initial and final, 60 + 5 at curve points; evaluation seed 12345; frozen policy; btt_eval_metrics_v1; every native clear replayed from tick 0 on a fresh process
unmatched_by_design: input width 15 vs 606 and parameters 11,538 vs 87,186; the [64, 64] tanh heads are identical
v1 keeps VecNormalize running observation statistics (its contract); v3 keys are pre-scaled and not normalised (its contract)
evaluation_basis: the final checkpoint set of each run (3,072,000 transitions), evaluated post hoc from tick 0 with frozen parameters; the run's own initial checkpoint set (ckpt_000000000) for the learning gate

denominators.K: verified clears over the 200 final episodes of a run (100 stochastic + 100 deterministic); a clear counts only when its canonical native actions, replayed from tick 0 on a fresh process, reproduce completion_time_passed AND completion_input_tick exactly; a native clear that does not reproduce is an integrity problem
denominators.T: mean targets broken over the final stochastic episodes of a run that are not verified clears (exact Fraction; the 100 stochastic episodes of the final label, minus verified clears); UNDEFINED (null) when that set is empty, never 0
denominators.X: 1 iff, among the 100 final stochastic episodes of the run, at least one has a replay-verified qualified wall crossing with a valid left-side landing OR at least one has a replay-verified left-target break (target 1, 6 or 8), by criterion btt_qualified_crossing_v1 (see crossing_verification); a raw first_left_entry alone is a supporting diagnostic; a candidate whose replay is not exact is an integrity problem
denominators.G: T of the run's final label minus T of the same run's initial label (ckpt_000000000, 100 stochastic episodes), v3 only; undefined when either T is undefined
denominators.D: T[v3][s] - T[v1][s], per seed; undefined when either T is undefined

crossing_verification.candidates: final stochastic episodes with a btt_eval_metrics_v1 first_left_entry or a left target (1, 6, 8) in broken_ids
crossing_verification.replay: canonical native actions from tick 0 on a fresh process (rl/m7f_trace.run_stepping_trace); flags {"SSB64_RAPHNET_DISABLE": "1", "SSB64_RL_NO_RENDER": "1", "SSB64_RL_TARGET_DIAG": "1"}
exact: replayed break table (id, consumed_tick) == recorded target_breaks
replayed first left entry consumed tick == recorded (both None or equal)
crossing_verification.entry: a live step E whose immediately preceding live step P has x_P >= left_boundary_x > x_E (the tick-0 observation is the predecessor of step 0); btt_reward_v3.classify_entry gives over_wall iff the y interpolated at the boundary is >= wall_top_y - entry_y_tolerance
crossing_verification.qualified_wall_crossing: entry class over_wall AND btt_crossing_evidence_v1 crossing_path == over_ledge AND a grounded takeoff (approach_surface) AND a valid left-side landing inside the same left visit (before the next exit)
crossing_verification.valid_left_side_landing: a live step with ground_air_state 0 that m7g_fixture.classify_ground matches (tolerance 1.0) to a decoded left-side floor line [3] and that is not the native-failure step
crossing_verification.left_target_break: the exact replay's break table contains target 1, 6 or 8
crossing_verification.X: 1 iff >= 1 qualified-crossing episode or >= 1 verified left-target-break episode in the label
recorded_never_required: right sweep complete at the entry
entry class and y_c of unqualified entries
procedure: candidates enumerated from the label's stochastic rows (btt_eval_metrics_v1 first_left_entry / broken_ids)

each candidate's canonical native actions replayed from tick 0 on a fresh process with read-only diagnostics (rl/m7n_crossing.verify_crossings_in; v3 labels under the run's evaluation flags + SSB64_RL_TARGET_DIAG=1, control labels under the M6 flags + SSB64_RL_TARGET_DIAG=1)
exactness checked (digest, consumed ticks, all actions, break table, first-left-entry tick); an inexact candidate is gate 0
the trace analysed by btt_qualified_crossing_v1; the document crossing_verification.json is always written, a label with zero candidates records X = 0 by the same criterion

control seeds: R4 of rl/m7n_control_check.py verifies the historical final labels and the R2 re-evaluation labels have identical candidate sets and applies the same verification; the campaign's verify-crossings repeats it on the historical finals and the analysis cross-checks both
the route label (btt_route_rule_v1 identity) and sweep-at-entry are recorded for every qualified crossing and never gate

undefined_quantities.representation: JSON null in every report; Fractions otherwise; never a substituted 0 or any other number
undefined_quantities.T: undefined when every stochastic episode of the label is a verified clear (the denominator is empty)
undefined_quantities.D: undefined when T[v3][s] or T[v1][s] is undefined
undefined_quantities.G: undefined when T of v3's final or initial label is undefined
undefined_quantities.gate_1: depends on K only; always applicable
undefined_quantities.gate_2: depends on K (guard) and X only; always applicable
undefined_quantities.gate_3_and_4: inapplicable unless D is defined in every seed; an inapplicable gate's condition is false and reported as inapplicable with its reason
undefined_quantities.gate_5: a seed with undefined G never counts as no-learning; inapplicable when fewer than no_learning_seeds_min seeds have G defined
undefined_quantities.gate_6: reached when no applicable gate holds; the report lists the inapplicable gates
undefined_quantities.consequence: an all-clear v3 label with no control clear is gate 1 by K alone; all-clear labels in both arms with equal clear counts are an inconclusive tie (gates 3-5 inapplicable), never a fabricated difference

conditions_any: the control reproduction check is missing, failed or bound to another code fingerprint / executable / rule
a v3 training run is not verified (identity, fresh start, provenance, rows, leak-free)
an evaluation label of either arm fails its verification (episode count, frozen statistics, tick-0 starts, metrics, artifacts)
a native clear of either arm is not reproduced by its replay
a v1 (control) label is incomplete or changed since the manifest
a gate-2 candidate (left entry or left-target break) of either arm whose replay is not exact, or a crossing verification document whose candidate set differs from the label's rows
the control's gate-2 inputs of the control check (R4) and of the campaign's verify-crossings disagree
integrity_gate.action: stop; no decision is recorded; diagnose

conditions_any: fewer than three verified v3 runs
a v3 final or initial label with fewer than 100 stochastic or 100 deterministic episodes (finals) / 100 stochastic (initial)
a stopped, failed or partial v3 run (preserved, never resumed for the comparison)
a v3 final label without its crossing verification document (verify-crossings not run)
incomplete.action: no decision; the arm is reported as incomplete, never as a failure or an inconclusive result

gates_in_order.name: first_clear
gates_in_order.condition: (sum_s K[v3][s] >= 1 and sum_s K[v1][s] == 0) or (K[v3][s] > K[v1][s] for every seed)
gates_in_order.action: preserve every verified clear and its checkpoint permanently; v3 becomes the Track 1 observation

gates_in_order.name: ceiling_broken
gates_in_order.condition: no gate 1; no control-clear guard; X[v3][s] == 1 in at least ceiling_seeds_min seeds and X[v1][s] == 0 in every seed, with X by btt_qualified_crossing_v1 (a replay-verified qualified wall crossing with a valid left-side landing, or a replay-verified left-target break)
gates_in_order.action: v3 selected for the next milestone; the qualified crossings / left-target breaks are already replayed and their traces, route labels and landings documented

gates_in_order.name: better_targets
gates_in_order.condition: no gate 1 or 2; no control-clear guard; D defined in every seed and D[s] >= targets_diff_min in every seed
gates_in_order.action: v3 selected for the next milestone

gates_in_order.name: worse
gates_in_order.condition: no gate 1-3; D defined in every seed and D[s] <= -targets_diff_min in every seed
gates_in_order.action: v1 stays; v3 recorded as worse at this budget; no extension

gates_in_order.name: no_learning
gates_in_order.condition: no gate 1-4; at least no_learning_seeds_min seeds have G defined and G[s] <= 0 in at least no_learning_seeds_min seeds (an undefined G never counts)
gates_in_order.action: v1 stays; v3 recorded as not learning from scratch at this budget; the representation is re-examined before any further v3 run

gates_in_order.name: no_benefit
gates_in_order.condition: anything else (seed disagreement in sign, |D| below the threshold in some seed, a v1-only clear, an unqualified left entry, an inapplicable gate 3-5, ...)
gates_in_order.action: v1 stays the default; v3 stays available and documented; this rule unlocks no extension

label_precedence: gate 0 (integrity) is evaluated first and stops everything; then incompleteness; then gates 1-6 in order, and the FIRST gate whose condition holds decides; every later gate's condition is still evaluated and reported, never used; an inapplicable gate (undefined inputs) never decides and evaluation continues to the next gate; gate 1 depends on K only, so a clear is decided before any T-based gate
tie_handling: all comparisons are inclusive on exact integers or Fractions, never rounded floats; an equal clear count in both arms (including 0 = 0) is not gate 1; K[v3][s] > K[v1][s] is strict per seed; D[s] exactly 1/2 counts for gate 3 and exactly -1/2 for gate 4; G[s] exactly 0 counts as no learning; X ties (1 = 1) are not gate 2; a v1-only verified clear engages the control-clear guard; X ties (1 = 1) are not gate 2 whether the control's qualified crossing is one episode or many; an exact but unqualified left entry (off-stage fall, airborne-only, landing on the failure step or off any decoded left floor) leaves X = 0; an undefined D or G is neither >= nor <= any threshold (the gate is inapplicable)
primary_outcome: gates 1-3 (success) are decided ONLY by normal tick-0 evaluation of frozen final checkpoints: a verified clear, a replay-verified qualified wall crossing with a valid left-side landing or a replay-verified left-target break, or the paired target difference
improvement_over_control: gate 1: K compared against the reproduced v1 control; ONE native-verified v3 clear with no control clear in any seed legitimately decides success (a single seed carries the first-clear condition), otherwise v3 must have strictly more verified clears in every seed; gate 2: X (qualified crossings / left-target breaks) in at least two v3 seeds and no control seed; gates 3 / 4: the paired difference D of mean final targets with a symmetric threshold of 1/2 target per episode in every seed. For gates 2-5 there is no pooling and no averaging across seeds, so one seed cannot carry those decisions; that statement does not apply to gate 1
progress_toward_tick0_clear: K is the clear itself; X is the ceiling (the three targets left of the tall wall that no policy has reached from tick 0), now evidenced by a replay-verified crossing with a landing or a verified left-target break; D is the ordinary target count. A success on gate 2 or 3 is progress, not a clear, and is reported as such

supporting_diagnostics_never_gating.T2: final stochastic tick-0 episodes with target 2 broken, per seed and pooled over 300 per arm (Phase K v1 control: 1, 0, 2 = 3 / 300); every tick-0 break is policy-initiated by construction, and no anchored or prefix evaluation exists in this campaign
supporting_diagnostics_never_gating.T2_break_context: for each target-2 break, its consumed tick and whether it fell within the M7l L definition (by the deadline with >= 5 static right targets), reported descriptively
supporting_diagnostics_never_gating.L_R: the M7l L and R counts (early target 2 with the statics; a seven-right sweep by the deadline), per seed
others: deterministic play: targets and collapse share (M7e definition)
per-checkpoint stochastic target curves of both arms
evaluation wall, peak processes, commit / physical minima
supporting_diagnostics_never_gating.left_entries: every btt_eval_metrics_v1 first_left_entry of both arms with its replay analysis: entry class (over_wall / under_stage / through_face / unpaired), y at the boundary, landing surface or none, native-failure step, route label (btt_route_rule_v1) and sweep-at-entry; unqualified entries (off-stage falls, airborne-only) are reported and never gate

budget.v3_training: 3 x 3,072,000 policy transitions (hard maximum; no extension, no extra seed)
budget.evaluation: 3 x 985 episodes (740 stochastic + 245 deterministic per run) plus clear replays

decision_recording: decided once by rl/m7n_analysis.decide on the frozen rule; recorded in runs/m7n/campaign/_matrix/analysis_n3.json and copied to docs; never re-decided
not_claims: no claim about individual feature contributions
no claim about checkpoint transfer to other characters (Mario is the only validated action-class mapping)
the omitted ledge column is a stage-coverage limitation of this contract, not evidence that ledge information is unnecessary
a gate-2 or gate-3 success is not a clear
a replay-verified qualified crossing is not a clear and not a route instruction
control_clear_guard: if sum_s K[v1][s] >= 1 and sum_s K[v3][s] == 0 (the control cleared from tick 0 and v3 never did), gates 2 and 3 cannot select v3; gates 4-6 are evaluated as usual (a worse or non-learning v3 is still recorded as such; otherwise the result is inconclusive and the v1 clear is reported)

known_control_values_gate2.source: the Phase K control's final stochastic labels have no first_left_entry and no left-target break in any of the 300 episodes (registered left_entries 0, left_target_episodes 0 per seed): zero candidates, X[v1][s] = 0 by the corrected criterion; verified by R4 of the control check and by verify-crossings
